thread:
Ivy (Design): just pushed a new riff for the rerank side-panel + export flow: https://www.figma.com/file/new-rerank-panel. Goals: make reranked subset explicit, shrink preview card, and tighten export copy.
Theo (PM): looks neat. main product ask: users need an obvious way to download only the reranked subset after applying filters and manual moves. show count in header.
Marta (Eng): agree. implementation concern: when users reorder results locally (drag/drop) we'll need to persist the order client-side and surface that ordering in the download. can do but note edge cases for pagination.
Omar (ML): also ask that the export include the rerank score and original rank columns. helps downstream evaluation.
Hana (A11y): a11y flags: the side-panel slide-in isn't announced. need role="dialog" and focus trap. also when reordering occurs, announce "Item X moved to position Y" for screen reader.
Ivy (Design): new copy proposal for the export CTA: "Download reranked set (CSV)" and secondary helper line: "Includes rerank score and current ordering. Filters and selections apply."
Sam (Product): +1. small tweak: helper line should mention "Only visible columns will be included" so users know column visibility matters.
design-bot: contrast check: export CTA #0A62FF on panel bg #FCFDFF passes AA for normal text. side-panel header badge #FFFFFF on #6B5AE8 passes.
Marta (Eng): for keyboard flow: when panel opens focus goes to panel title, tab order: title -> actions -> list -> each item -> preview toggle. expanding preview moves focus into preview, ESC collapses and returns focus to the toggle.
Hana (A11y): sample ARIA for drag announcements:
```
// after reorder
liveRegion.textContent = `Moved ${itemLabel} to position ${newIndex}`;
```
and preview toggle should be `button aria-expanded` with `aria-controls`.
Ivy (Design): will update Figma to include the live region and helper text. also adding a compact preview option (icon) to reduce height for dense lists.
Omar (ML): one more: when downloading the reranked set, include a header row with metadata: model, rerank-config-id, time. that's useful for experiments.
Sam (Product): fine with metadata, but make it opt-out in modal so CSVs remain clean by default. add a small checkbox "Include rerank metadata (model, config)".
Marta (Eng): note about large sets: if export > 10k rows we should switch to background export with email/push link rather than blocking the client. show "10k+" shorthand in UI counts.
Hana (A11y): final checklist: 1) role=dialog & focus trap 2) announce panel open 3) aria-live for reorder 4) aria-expanded & labels for preview 5) modal announced on open. I'll validate after Figma update.
Ivy (Design): great, I'll make the copy and ARIA changes and upload by EOD. aiming to handoff tomorrow. thanks team :raised_hands:
